verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a recurring annual charge for its registered agent service ($299 per state per year), which covers the renewal-charge half of the story. Nothing documents cancellation, offboarding, or transferring the registered agent out to another provider. The only transfer evidence is about switching TO Firstbase. Missing for 10: cancellation terms, transfer-out/registered-agent change-away process, auto-renewal notice or refund policy, evidence that leaving does not strand the entity.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity
